resolvedFindings.rationale: assertPinnedIdentityRuntime runs before this point. It requires data/glossary.json (a runtimeData entry) to be a regular non-symlink file whose blob hash equals current.regular(...).oid, and it requires all transitive construction code at codeRoot to match pinned blobs. Glossary changes between retained and current are also blocked, because data/glossary.json does not match the changed-chapter regex. That binds the runtime matcher to both commits. The dirty-glossary regression (test line 82) and the normalizationGlossaryBlob receipt cover it. Only a theoretical check-to-use race is left, which is outside this packet's threat model.
